Regarding the historic site on the National Register, there should be a clear statement made of the project's effect on that site following the direction of 36 CFR 800. Regarding the potential historic district, there should be a report of eligibility determination. Such a determination can be secured upon HUD's request to the Chief, Office of Archeology and Historic Preservation, National Park Service, Washington, D. C. 20240. The final environmental statement should adequately discuss these two historic site/district matters.
